title: `_process_stack` cyclomatic complexity 22 (70 lines)
detail: `_process_stack` (lines 527–617) has CCN=22 across 70 lines. Each additional branch multiplies test cases needed for full coverage. Fix: extract one or more decision-heavy sub-routines.

title: 2× exception raised without `from` in except block (W0707, first at line 203)
detail: At 2 location(s) (first at line 203), a new exception is raised inside an `except` block without `raise ... from original_exc`. This discards the original traceback and makes debugging harder. Fix: `raise NewExc(...) from exc` to preserve the chain.

title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 527
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.

title: 4× unused argument (W0613) — e.g. `request`, `request`, `content_type`
detail: 4 function arguments are never used within their function bodies. This often signals an interface mismatch or a method that should be `@staticmethod`. Fix: use the argument, or prefix with `_` if it's an intentionally unused interface slot.
